choices.C01: Flagged rows would enter every statistic; no row of any piece is flagged (resid_flag false everywhere).
choices.C02: I = mean over regions of the within-region mean |phi| (each region weighs 1, its rows 1/n_r); on a draw each drawn copy of a region weighs 1.
choices.C03: Signed mean S with the same region weighting as I, phi in place of |phi|.
choices.C04: j in J when I_m(j) > 1e-12 * sum_k I_m(k) (region-weighted, full sample, strict) for some model; a zero-total model adds nothing.
choices.C05: Some model = every model of per_lead.json models (cross-link and declined included); one J per problem and level for every statistic; B1 never enters it.
choices.C06: A player without a column has phi 0 for that model (I, S, share 0; ranked with the zeros by name); structural zeros = union of all models' columns minus J.
choices.C07: J, B1's pair J and the determined signs fixed at the full sample; top-k sets, their unions and the consensus found again on each draw.
choices.C08: n_J has no interval (J fixed); n_nonzero, sign_n_determined and sign_n_agree get intervals (recomputed per draw).
choices.C09: Nonzero = I_m(j) > 0 (phi != 0 on some row), counted over the model's own columns (outside J too); equals meta.json's counts.
choices.C10: Ties = exact float64 equality of I; average ranks; ordered rankings: larger I first, ties by the player name (with x__/c__ prefix) in Python string order ascending.
choices.C11: Spearman = Pearson correlation of average ranks; top-20 union: ranks taken again within the union of the two top-20 sets.
choices.C12: Fewer than k players: the top-k set is all of J; top-20 Jaccard only when the full-sample J (B1: the pair's J) has 200 or more players.
choices.C13: RBO = ((1-p)/p) sum_{d=1..k} (X_d/d) p^d + (X_k/k) p^k over the full tie-broken rankings of J (eq. 32 with s = l = k); self-RBO = 1.
choices.C14: TV = 0.5 * sum |s_a - s_b| over J (shares over J); family TV = 0.5 * sum over the five family shares.
choices.C15: Family attribution = row sum of all its variables' variable-level phi; importance = region-weighted mean |sum|; shares over the five families; empty family = 0; feature pairs reuse it.
choices.C16: Precedence normal > hist_* > calendar/ctx:* > global-index rule > local drivers; one value per time step = exact equality at every test time step, missing counted as a value.
choices.C17: Determined: percentile 95% interval of S excludes 0 strictly (fixed); agreement = n_agree / n_determined on the union of the two top-10 sets, null when n_determined = 0.
choices.C18: Undefined (null/NaN): Spearman or tau-b with an all-tied side, sign agreement with nothing determined, W with fewer than two rankings, main-row rival numbers of fire, item 8 draws without such rows.
choices.C19: W over the main set on the level's J with the tie correction 12S/(m^2(n^3-n) - m sum T); mean pairwise Spearman = mean of the main-set pairs' Spearman over J.
choices.C20: Stability = mean over the finite draws of Spearman(full-sample I, draw I) over J; no interval (n_finite null).
choices.C21: numpy.percentile linear interpolation at 2.5 and 97.5 over the finite draws only; an interval whenever at least one draw is finite.
choices.C22: Median over rivals (even count: mean of the two middle values), recomputed per draw; the range as min and max, each with its own per-draw interval.
choices.C23: The median of the rivals' own-history shares (per draw); a rival is named only when the count is odd and exactly one rival has the median value.
choices.C24: Own-history share = the own-history family share of C15.
choices.C25: Every arcsine-link model of every problem (coral 4, fire 1); its own rows with pre > 0; variable level over the level's J; regions with such rows weigh 1; intervals from the same draws.
choices.I01: Region = rows.parquet column group (same row and group in every piece; G distinct groups = the draw matrix's columns).
choices.I02:
Row b = draw b, column k = k-th region drawn; value = index into sorted(distinct group); the matrix is reproduced by SHA-256('shap_v1|AW4|

|0||')[:8] mod G.
choices.I03: The SHA-256 covers every byte of the .npy file (header and data); it equals per_lead.json draws_sha256 on all five problems.
choices.I04:
The lead's test set = the rivals' export of the headline run, D:\treeroute\rival_export\

\\lead_0\test\*.parquet; read unit, time, issue and the candidate x__ columns.
choices.I05: The registered sample = the sample= field of the problem's SAMPLE_REGISTER.txt line (leads include 0); every B1 meta.json matches it.
choices.I06: A log line's time is its bracketed time; B1 lines from 2026-11-15 23:06:00; set-up line = first with 'background pairs', done line = first 'done in' after it.
choices.X01: An arcsine model's nonzero rows use its own pre column.
choices.X02: The families named by their columns take precedence over the global-index test (calendar stays context and calendar).
choices.X03: The feature-level pairs' tv_family_shares equals the variable-level one (families come from variable-level phi).
choices.X04: main_row.kendall_w is the variable-level W of item 5, computed again.
choices.X05: A J player with zero importance on a draw keeps share 0 and ranks with the zeros by name.
